consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the 1981-12-09 show at the Events Center was a powerful and energetic performance, highlighted by standout moments in the first and second sets. The China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider and Scarlet Begonias > Fire on the Mountain transitions were particularly praised for their intensity and musicianship.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.4 for 46 reviews + 1.2 sentiment: The overall enthusiasm for the performance, particularly the standout songs and the energy of the crowd, significantly elevates the perceived quality of the show.
